name: tt-tnt-1024
description: TT-TNT-1024 -- a Llama-3-style model sized for Tenstorrent: num_groups=4 so it shards across 1, 2 or 4 chips, and a derived SwiGLU width of 2816 (88 tiles = 8x11) that fits a harvested Blackhole grid at 80%. Weights are the 2048-context run (2026-08-28): 123M parameters, 10,764 steps, retrained from the 'dialogue' lineage at a 2048-token context (up from 512) to push a real growing-conversation KV-cache crash -- confirmed a generic tt-metal/vLLM defect, not this model, see docs/upstream-tt-metal-asks.md entry 6 -- far out of ordinary reach. Also ships a chat template capping rendered conversation history to the last 5 messages as a backstop. Matched-window (512) loss improved -0.2318 nats against the prior checkpoint; no behavioural signal cleared the seed floor in either direction (n=1 seed).
